templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
templates.description: Standard Terms for a mutual NDA that lets each party disclose confidential information for a defined purpose, covering use, protection, exceptions, term, and return of confidential information. Pairs with the Mutual NDA Cover Page.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
templates.description: Fill-in Cover Page that incorporates the Mutual NDA Standard Terms, capturing the purpose, effective date, term, confidentiality period, governing law, and signatures.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for providing a cloud/SaaS service, covering access and use, support, customer content, machine learning, payment, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for early design partners who get pre-release access to a product in exchange for feedback and participation in a development program, covering feedback ownership, confidentiality, and IP.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: SLA Standard Terms defining target uptime and response-time commitments for a cloud service, the method for calculating availability, and service credit remedies.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for delivering professional services and deliverables under statements of work, covering change orders, acceptance, IP assignment, payment, warranties, liability, insurance, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: DPA Standard Terms governing the processing of personal data between controller/processor and processor/subprocessor, including subprocessors, restricted transfers (EEA SCCs and UK Addendum), security incidents, audits, and deletion.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms licensing installable software for defined permitted uses, covering user accounts, updates, open source, restrictions, payment, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for a business partnership between two companies, covering each party's obligations, fees, a trademark/brand license, privacy, dispute escalation, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for a time-limited pilot giving a customer evaluation access to a product, covering license, customer content, restrictions, term and termination, disclaimers, liability, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA BAA Standard Terms setting out a business associate's obligations for protected health information (PHI), including permitted uses, safeguards, subcontractors, breach notification, and term and termination.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum supplementing an existing agreement to cover AI/ML services, including use of input and output, model training restrictions, ownership of output, personal data, and AI-specific disclaimers.
